overview: Task graph for generating a frozen-input financial research report on SMIC (688981.SS) FY2024 with strict citation and compliance requirements.
research_topic: 中芯国际 (688981.SS) formal FY2024 frozen-input report
requirements: Cover executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation or limitation, risks, and investment conclusion.
Emit explicitly labeled critical claims and body citations.

tasks.description: Retrieve all available frozen snapshot evidence for SMIC (688981.SS) FY2024 including annual report filings, financial statements, market data, and news. Use retrieve_local_evidence and fetch_yahoo_market_snapshot. Return ranked evidence records with evidence_ids.
tasks.expected_output: List of evidence records with evidence_id, source, title, date, and content snippets.

tasks.description: Using evidence from task_001, compute financial ratios, three-statement view, peer comparison, and valuation. Identify gaps in data. Provide evidence-backed claims for each metric.
tasks.expected_output: Structured claims with evidence_ids covering balance sheet, income statement, cash flow, ratios, peer comparison, and valuation.

tasks.description: Based on evidence from task_001 and analysis from task_002, identify key risks (operational, financial, market, regulatory) and form an investment conclusion with supporting citations. Output claims with evidence_ids.
tasks.expected_output: Claims for risks and investment conclusion, each with evidence_ids.

tasks.description: Assemble all claims, tables, charts into a structured Chinese research report covering executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation/limitation, risks, and investment conclusion. Include citations, charts, and compliance disclosure. Output markdown, HTML, JSON payloads.
tasks.expected_output: Three files: report.md, report.html, report.json with complete content and citations.

tasks.description: Verify that every material factual claim has an evidence_id citation, no unsupported numbers, compliance disclosure present, and format matches requirements. If fails, return revision brief to previous tasks.
tasks.expected_output: Verification pass or revision brief with specific issues.
